description: This file defines an interface for survey reading operations in the Fineract project, specifying methods to retrieve surveys, survey overviews, and survey entries.

classes.name: ReadSurveyService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for reading survey data, including retrieval of all surveys, specific surveys, client score overviews, and survey entries.

methods.name: retrieveAllSurveys
methods.description: Returns a list of all surveys available.

methods.name: retrieveSurvey
methods.description: Retrieves a specific survey by name.

methods.name: retrieveClientSurveyScoreOverview
methods.description: Retrieves a score overview for a specific client and survey.

methods.name: retrieveClientSurveyScoreOverview
methods.description: Retrieves a score overview for a client across surveys.

methods.name: retrieveSurveyEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific survey entry for a client based on survey name, client ID, and entry ID.
